newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks and Solidere shares mixed in Beiru.
newsitem.headline: Banks and Solidere shares mixed in Beiru.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday as Audi shares held steady at $16.25 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares fell to $12 from $12.125.
Solidere A shares fell slightly to $10.625 from Tuesday's $10.75 while B shares rose to $11.125 from $11.
Turnover in BLC was 4,500 shares from 4,100 and volume of trade in Audi shares was 19,778 shares from 27,762.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 106,687 shares compared with 100,367 and value was $1,271,079 against $1,246,299.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.03 percent to 918.93 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.11 percent to 81.65.
